name: Cinderella
source:
The lazy son of a nouveau riche family. He has a haughty attitude and believes everything can be settled with the power of money. Though he's the owner of a cafe (which is also his home), he leaves the shop entirely up to his younger brothers while he loafs around all day long. However, on the inside, he's actually as delicate as glass.

[SPOILER]His family was once extremely wealthy, however, his father's business dealings went bad and they became neck-deep in debt. Cinderella is a co-signee of a loan his father took from a loan shark. Having grown up rich, Cinderella has a poor concept of managing money, made worse by his going on shopping sprees as an escape and front to pretend that his family is still well-off instead of repaying the massive loan.[/SPOILER]

[Based on [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/10/17/taisho-alice-introduction/]Otome Jikan's translated profile of him[/URL].]
